records.subject: Welcome aboard, Cedar Group
records.body:
Hi Wei,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Re: faster way to add your team
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

Thanks for flagging this 
doing it one by one for a team your size isn't the way. Good news: teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, so you don't have to add people individually. Your ticket on this is still open on our side, and I'll make sure it gets a clear answer there too.

If it's useful, I'm happy to walk through your first bulk invite with you on a short call this week 
send me a couple of times that work and I'll make one fit.

Best,
Nadia
